name: (03) Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 2 Intermediate — Terrorize

system.description:
The infernalist drags a victim's worst fear into seeming reality, a hundred cobras flooding the room or the very floor falling away, so vivid and omnipresent that it all but paralyzes them.

Bid a number of Mental Traits equal to the victim's Courage Traits and defeat them in a Mental Challenge. On a loss they must either succeed in a Courage Virtue Test against a four-Trait difficulty or spend a Mental Trait to take any action except cowering in fear. Terrorize lasts for the rest of the scene, and requires line of sight to activate. Retest with Intimidation.
